_comment: PubMed 官方 Clinical Queries 检索过滤器 + 常用文献类型过滤器。按 NCBI Clinical Queries 规格整理（https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/advanced/clinical-queries/）。这些是检索式片段，会被 AND 进你的检索式。

therapy.narrow.label: 治疗 · 窄（高质量 RCT）
therapy.narrow.query: ((clinical[Title/Abstract] AND trial[Title/Abstract]) OR clinical trials as topic[MeSH Terms:noexp] OR clinical trial[Publication Type] OR random*[Title/Abstract] OR random allocation[MeSH Terms:noexp] OR therapeutic use[MeSH Subheading:noexp])

therapy.broad.label: 治疗 · 宽（含临床试验类研究）
therapy.broad.query: ((clinical[Title/Abstract] AND trial[Title/Abstract]) OR clinical trials as topic[MeSH Terms] OR clinical trial[Publication Type] OR random*[Title/Abstract] OR random allocation[MeSH Terms] OR therapeutic use[MeSH Subheading])

diagnosis.narrow.label: 诊断 · 窄
diagnosis.narrow.query: ((diagnosis[Title/Abstract] AND (diagnostic[Title/Abstract] OR differential[Title/Abstract])) OR (diagnostic imaging[MeSH Terms] OR diagnostic techniques and procedures[MeSH Terms]) OR (diagnostic[MeSH Terms] OR "diagnosis"[MeSH Terms])) NOT (animal[MeSH Terms] NOT humans[MeSH Terms])

diagnosis.broad.label: 诊断 · 宽
diagnosis.broad.query: ((diagnosis[Title/Abstract] AND (diagnostic[Title/Abstract] OR differential[Title/Abstract])) OR (diagnostic imaging[MeSH Terms] OR diagnostic techniques and procedures[MeSH Terms]) OR (diagnostic[MeSH Terms] OR "diagnosis"[MeSH Terms]))

prognosis.narrow.label: 预后 · 窄
prognosis.narrow.query: ((prognos*[Title/Abstract] OR predict*[Title/Abstract] OR outcome*[Title/Abstract]) AND (population[Title/Abstract] OR "population"[MeSH Terms] OR "follow-up"[MeSH Terms] OR "follow up"[Title/Abstract] OR "course"[Title/Abstract] OR "duration"[Title/Abstract])) NOT (animal[MeSH Terms] NOT humans[MeSH Terms])

prognosis.broad.label: 预后 · 宽
prognosis.broad.query: ((prognos*[Title/Abstract] OR predict*[Title/Abstract] OR outcome*[Title/Abstract]) OR (population[MeSH Terms] OR "follow-up"[MeSH Terms] OR "follow up"[Title/Abstract] OR "course"[Title/Abstract] OR "duration"[Title/Abstract]))

etiology.label: 病因 / 危险因素
etiology.query: ((etiol*[Title/Abstract] OR causal*[Title/Abstract] OR "risk factor"[Title/Abstract] OR "risk factors"[Title/Abstract] OR incidence[Title/Abstract]) AND (population[Title/Abstract] OR "population"[MeSH Terms] OR persons[Title/Abstract] OR humans[Title/Abstract])) NOT (animal[MeSH Terms] NOT humans[MeSH Terms])

rct.label: 仅随机对照试验
rct.query: (randomized controlled trial[Publication Type] OR (randomized[Title/Abstract] AND controlled[Title/Abstract] AND trial[Title/Abstract]))

review.label: 仅系统综述 / Meta 分析
review.query: (review[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR "meta analysis"[Title/Abstract] OR "systematic review"[Title/Abstract])

observational.label: 观察性研究（队列 / 病例对照）
observational.query: (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR "cohort study"[Title/Abstract] OR case-control[Title/Abstract] OR "case control"[Title/Abstract] OR longitudinal[Title/Abstract] OR cross-sectional[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract]) NOT (randomized[Title/Abstract] OR random allocation[MeSH Terms])

guideline.label: 指南 / 共识 / 实践规范
guideline.query: (guideline[Publication Type] OR practice guideline[Publication Type] OR consensus development conference[Publication Type] OR guideline[Title/Abstract] OR "clinical practice guideline"[Title/Abstract] OR consensus[Title/Abstract])
